purpose: Turn the landed Artist Headquarters shell into an explicit reusable design/accessibility contract rather than a pile of incidental CSS: centralize semantic shell tokens and interaction rules, make selected controls screen-reader-readable, harden high-contrast/forced-colors and narrow-screen behavior, and add executable representative-state fixtures that prove current consumer states preserve Artist/Song/Focus context and hide developer plumbing.

lineage.outcome: The current Headquarters states remain understandable and operable across keyboard, screen-reader, high-contrast and narrow-screen use, and their accepted interaction invariants are executable instead of living only in prose.
lineage.capability: Canonical Headquarters shell design and accessibility contract

n0te2_dependencies: UX-01A landed Artist Headquarters front door
legacy_rejections: screenshot pixels promoted to immutable product doctrine
keyboard shortcuts that collide with browser/DAW conventions
fake loading/offline/provider states with no truthful product substrate

completion_proof: shell presentation tokens and interaction/accessibility CSS live in one reusable clean-room design module rather than duplicated incidental strings
current toggle-like Focus choices expose selected state with aria-pressed in addition to visual styling
keyboard focus remains visibly distinct; status meaning remains textual/non-color-only; forms retain explicit labels and semantic landmarks
prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-contrast and forced-colors environments receive explicit safe CSS behavior without depending on animation, gradients or custom color alone
very narrow layouts preserve comfortable navigation/control targets by scrolling/reflowing rather than compressing route controls below the product target
long Artist/Song labels wrap without forcing the primary shell wider than its viewport contract

an executable canonical-state fixture enumerates the representative shell states currently implemented: first profile, profile selection, no Song, active Song, no Focus, active Focus, settings, blocked ownership and recovery
real HTTP regression walks each supported representative state against required artist-language, landmark/action and prohibited-internal-token invariants from the fixture
fixtures do not fabricate provider/offline/loading/release/job states that are not yet truthfully implemented; those remain retained downstream design states
existing Artist/Song/Focus persistence, security headers, one-shot action authority and explicit Quit/recovery semantics remain behaviorally unchanged
authored fixture/regression proof stays separate from executed evidence; empty hosted evidence remains UNOBSERVED
non_scope: captions/transcripts for media surfaces that do not yet exist
next_selection_rule: After UX-01C lands, audit the remaining UX-01 obligations by truthful product substrate. Do not turn visual fixtures into final brand doctrine, do not claim inaccessible future states are implemented, and do not select performance/Not Now/Job work until their required runtime objects or measurement environment exist.
